hardware_family: Provisional M8 x 40 male hand knob, rotating loss-protection ring and short retaining tether; metal-backed shelf captive thread; positively threaded parking socket. No selected supplier or custom metal.
parking_block_construction: Two identical 18 mm plywood pads per lock, glued and positively screwed to floor; threaded parking socket only, never upright clamp support.
hardware_dimensions_authority: Explicit conservative packaging decisions, not measured or purchased specifications. Thread engagement, washers, retention ring and parking socket require physical qualification.
washer_retention: Load-spreading washer captive on shank using a common retaining washer; physical stack confirmation required.
mechanical_tether_stow: Surplus mechanically retained around the knob with a reusable positive cord keeper, in both engaged and parked states. Free arch is a hand-guided operation corridor only, never the unrestrained fold state.
